svg.aria-label: main.tsp, the TypeSpec source for the AgentIx.Semantic.Core namespace, compiles with the @typespec/json-schema emitter into 37 JSON Schema documents under generated/json-schema/. A JSON Schema validator checks a field declaration against FieldDecl.json and answers true or false. Three tables ship beside them: inventory.json, kernel-scalars.json (11 scalars) and lowering.json (62 rows).
